sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.detail: one sentence, from memory, before document work
sections.markdown: What I believe the market narrative is: SSMS.JK is a Central Kalimantan palm planter controlled by CBI (Abdul Rasyid), known for high yields on young trees, refinancing sensitivity, and related-party dealings with CBI's downstream arm.

sections.heading: Earnings quality gate
sections.markdown:
- **Accruals & cash conversion**: 3y accruals `(NI − CFO)/avg assets` ran **−0.92% (FY23A)**, **−1.25% (FY24A)**, **+0.83% (FY25A)** (`fund record` F112–F114; `data/dossiers/SSMS.fund record`). CFO/Group NI was **1.20x / 1.18x / 0.91x** (0.95x parent FY25), reflecting Rp673.8bn NWC build (21.5% of rev; `fund record`). Biological-asset gains (PSAK 69) are undisclosed in press summaries (`fund record`, `fund record`), but tight CFO/NI rules out divergence.
- **DHE SDA lockup vs debt (optics/liquidity)**: At 30 Sep 2026, **Rp3,200bn** restricted DHE cash is locked up to 12m (`F46`, `fund record`, `fund record`) plus **Rp904.0bn** unrestricted cash (`F45`), while gross debt rose from Rp8,423.1bn (`dossier`) to **Rp12,029.3bn** (`F101`, `fund record`). Ex-DHE current assets (**Rp7,900bn**) trail current liabilities (**Rp9,480bn**, 0.83x; `F47`, `F49`), despite Rp800bn FY25 (`F52`) and Rp500bn FY26 interim dividends (`F54`, `fund record`).
- **CBI RPT & footnote gaps (structure/optics)**: 62.30% parent CBI (`F17`) sold 63.4% of SML (11,046 ha) to SSMS on 24 Nov 2025 for **Rp1,600bn** debt-funded (`F14–F18`, `fund record`). Third-party sales dominate (`fund record`), yet audited LK footnotes (CBI/CBUT RPT sales/receivables, auditor opinion) and IDX notation registers (B/E/L/M/S) are inaccessible (`fund record`, `fund record` §6). Pack G&A D&A (Rp73bn) understates cash-flow group D&A (Rp568.3bn FY25, `F60`).
- **HSC & FTSE exit**: On BEI's HSC list (`fund record`, `fund record`), excluded from IHSG (`fund record`), and deleted by **FTSE Russell** effective **21 Dec 2026** (`F102`, `fund record`). Registry free float is **29.16%** (`fund record`, 15%-compliant); absent from Sep-2026 special-monitoring release list (`fund record`). **Verdict**: Optics/governance flags only; zero manipulation-class flags.

DHE] − SML minority Rp391bn; ex-DHE **IDR 1,744/sh**; flat-$1,150/t NAV **IDR 1,941/sh**; SML land `F100` Rp26.4tn EV). **Bear IDR 559/sh** ($886/t FY27E->$1,060 LT, 0.95x vol, $8/t DSI, 50% DHE haircut). **Bull IDR 3,525/sh** ($1,450/t FY27E->$1,265 LT, 1.05x vol, $2/t DSI).

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** At Rp960–970 (2026-11-28 screen), SSMS is an un-investable HSC/konglo trap facing **21-Dec-2026 FTSE passive selling** and a below-deck CPO cycle (~$1,121/t implied).
**Why wrong:** Thin coverage (NEGLECTED #3) misses 9M26 Parent NI +58.4% YoY (`F34`) and SML's ramp; compressing our 12m-rolled prob-weighted DCF (**Rp2,184**) via the HSC konglo lens (0.577x kept; `fund record`) yields **Rp1,260/sh**, plus **14.0% net div yield** at our **Rp860** limit entry inside the konglo bear zone (Rp835–884) to catch FTSE supply.
**What proves us wrong:** CPO retesting $886/t (`d.agri.cpo`) with DSI fees >$8/t, another debt-funded CBI RPT, or DHE refinancing stress.

sections.heading: House coverage reconciliation
sections.markdown: House coverage (`fund record`, `fund record`) sets `tp_fundamental` **Rp2,920.6/sh** and konglo `tp_final` **Rp1,403.5/sh** (BUY vs Rp955). Our Phase-1 Base DCF (**Rp2,080/sh**) and 12m-rolled prob-weighted value (**Rp2,184/sh**) sit ~25% below `tp_fundamental` because we: (1) apply **12.2% WACC** (25% tax vs house 22%/11.39% WACC), (2) deduct **US$4/t Jan-2027 DSI export fee**, and (3) anchor solely on DCF rather than P/BV and EV/EBITDA cross-checks. Applying the same 0.577x HSC lens yields our **Rp1,260** target (-10.2% vs `tp_final`), while we rest a **Rp860 limit entry** into the 21-Dec FTSE deletion.

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.markdown:
1. **FTSE 21 Dec 2026 deletion & HSC IHSG exit**: Excluded from IHSG (`fund record`, `fund record`) and FTSE global indices at 21 Dec open (`F102`, `fund record`), removing passive bids on Rp6.10–6.38bn/day ADTV while MSCI's Standalone review runs to 30 Jun 2027.
2. **Tight ex-DHE liquidity**: 30 Sep 2026 gross debt hit Rp12,029.3bn (`F101`), and current liabilities (Rp9,480bn, `F49`) exceed ex-DHE current assets (Rp7,900bn) as Rp500bn interim dividend pays 2 Dec 2026 (`F54`, `fund record`).
3. **CBI RPT leverage & footnote gap**: Rp1,600bn SML deal paid 62.3% parent CBI via group-secured debt (`F16–F18`, `fund record`); primary RPT footnotes and IDX notation registers remain unverified (`fund record`).

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is Nov 2029 and SSMS lost >30%: CPO fell to $886/t (`FY23A` trough) as El Nino faded while DSI fees compressed netbacks; FY27E EBITDA halved to ~Rp1.7tn, forcing a dividend cut under Rp12tn debt. MSCI downgraded Indonesia to Standalone in Jun 2027, keeping HSC discounts wide, and a break below Rp560 hit a **25% IDX ARB lock**, filling near **Rp420 (-51.2% vs Rp860)**.

sections.markdown: Conviction **3/5**; edge from NEGLECTED #3 thin coverage + 21-Dec FTSE supply limit entry. **EV & Kelly (`commodity_capex_turnaround`: prior `0.42`, horizon `3y`, lib Kelly +42.7% / quarter-Kelly +10.7%, lib `up/|down|` 2.14)**: `p_up = 0.42` (zero probability shading; conservatism is in Rp860 entry and Rp1,260 target), `up_pct +46.5%`, `down_pct -34.9%`, net div `14.0%/yr` (10% WHT), drag `1.0%` -> **EV +15.9%**, `up_leg/|down_leg| = 2.44` (price-only 1.33), **own-Kelly +50.7% (quarter-Kelly +12.7%)**. Under a **25% ARB-gapped exit** at Rp420 (`-51.2%`), quarter-Kelly is **+3.5%**. 7d exit @ 20% of Rp6.38bn ADTV caps size at **Rp8.9bn (~6.0% of INDO book)**; watch CPO overlap and HSC/DHE flags.

Yet accruals omit `fund record` **9M26 OCF −Rp2,441.6bn** (`Q2 −651.4`, `Q3 −1,914.8`; LTM −Rp2,564.3bn) vs Rp1,750bn NI. [MATERIAL]

Paying Rp134/sh gross (~Rp1.28tn/yr) conflicts with −Rp2,813.5bn 9M26 FCF, Rp6,855bn current debt (`datapack`), 0.83x ex-DHE current ratio, and pledged DHE. At 5% net yield + ARB kill (`Rp420`, −51.2%), EV hits **−4.8%** (`qK −3.8%`). Spot CPO (`$1,180`) trails FY27E `$1,240`; at `$992` (0.8x deck), `fund record` value drops >50%. [FATAL]
2. **Variant perception:** "NEGLECTED #3" mispricing contradicts priors admitting refinancing/RPT sensitivity. Market prices HSC exclusions, 62.3% CBI control, Rp1,600bn debt-funded SML RPT, and 10x trough-EBITDA leverage. [MATERIAL]
3. **Catalyst:** Zero 12m positive catalyst; FTSE deletes SSMS **21-Dec-2026** on **Rp6.1bn** ADTV (~15d/1% float), MSCI Standalone freeze runs to **30-Jun-2027** (`fund record`), and CBI has no float-expansion plan. [MATERIAL]
4. **Base rate & sleeve:** `commodity_capex_turnaround` (`0.42`) ignores **MOMENTUM #2** (`mom6 +46.5%`, `mom12 −35.4%`) and konglo traps (`holdco_discount_narrowing` `0.33`). At `p_up=0.33` and ARB −51.2%, EV is **−6.1%** even at 14% yield. [FATAL]
5. **Sizing (both directions):** `560=9% net dividend without new debt. [MATERIAL]
11. **Verdict:** **KILL_RECOMMENDED** — SSMS’s +15.9% EV relies entirely on a 14%/yr dividend carry unfunded by −Rp2,442bn 9M26 OCF and contradicted by SELL-rated 70%-owned CBUT’s cash-collateralized DHE/debt filings in our archive. [FATAL]

sections.heading: Judge verdict
sections.markdown:
**VERDICT: KILL** (`reason_tag: fragile_estimates`)

Applying the standing correction against inception over-killing (35/40 kills, 12/28 leaving gains) amid 80.5% INDO cash and 4/8 live names: a marginal name warrants `PASS_REDUCED`, and Rule 6a construction defects return as `REVISE`. Here, however, Dani and Drew both converged on `KILL_RECOMMENDED` after archive filings broke the thesis's single load-bearing return driver—a dispositive flaw, not a construction defect.

1. **Process & base rate:** `estimates_committed_at` (`10:10:44`) precedes `draft` (`10:13:11`); `stage_log` is monotonic across `draft -> attacked -> revision -> re_attacked -> judged`. Lowering `p_up` from `0.42` (`commodity_capex_turnaround`) to `0.33` (`holdco_discount_narrowing` prior) reflects HSC/FTSE deletion (`21-Dec-2026`) and MSCI Standalone (`30-Jun-2027`) discount persistence.
2. **Broken load-bearing assumption (dispositive flaw):** The initial `+15.9%` EV depended entirely on an unfunded `14.0%/yr` (`+42.0pp`) net dividend carry (price-only EV `-1.7%`). `SSMS.JK/datapack.json` shows `-Rp2,441.6bn` 9M26 OCF and `Rp6,855.0bn` current debt, while `CBUT.JK/facts.yaml` proves 70.22%-owned SELL-rated CBUT holds `Rp3.30tn` restricted DHE cash collateralizing `Rp5.24tn` ST loans (`F13–F14`, `F16`). Consolidated DHE is encumbered, not free payout capacity.
3. **Negative EV & house reconciliation:** Cutting net yield to `5.0%` and widening kill to `Rp420` (`-51.2%` for 25% IDX ARB gap) produces `-15.0%` EV (`0.0%` Kelly) at `Rp860`, and remains `-5.9%` even at Drew's `Rp700` washout level. House coverage (`tp_final` Rp1,403.5) is reconciled via WACC, DSI fee, and unmodelled CBUT/OCF strain.
4. **Resubmission bar:** Locked 30 days (`exits.judge_kill_cooldown_days`) unless `supersedes:` brings audited FY26 LK proving ex-CBUT OCF covers the payout without debt.
